app.name: Iskra
elsewhere.message: Iskra can only run in one window at a time — otherwise its encryption keys get tangled. Switch to that window, or open Iskra here and it will close there.
elsewhere.title: Iskra is already open in another window
room.noRoomSelectedMessage: Choose a conversation to start reading.
roomList.emptyMessage: When someone messages you, it’ll show up here.
roomList.title: Chats
session.ended.message: Your server has stopped accepting this session. You most likely ended it from another device. Sign in again — none of your conversations have gone anywhere.
session.ended.title: You are no longer signed in
session.offlineMessage: Your conversations are here, on this device. We just can’t reach the server right now — check your network.
signIn.problem.badCredentials: That username or password didn’t work. Try again.
signIn.problem.notFound: We couldn’t find an account service at that address. Check the spelling and try again.
signIn.problem.ssoIncomplete: That sign-in didn’t complete. Give it another go.
signIn.problem.storageUnavailable: Iskra couldn’t set up secure storage on this device, so it can’t sign you in safely.
signIn.problem.unreachable: Something went wrong reaching that address. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.problem.unsupportedMethod: That service uses a way of signing in that Iskra doesn’t support yet.
signIn.readyHelp: We’ll open your server’s page so you can sign in the usual way.
signIn.title: Welcome to Iskra
signIn.usePasswordInstead: I only have a username and password
signIn.whereIsAccountHelp: If someone gave you an address to use, type it here. If not, matrix.org works for most people.
signOut.confirmMessage: Your conversations and encryption keys will be removed from this device. You’ll need your recovery key to read older messages here again.
storage.dock.message: Safari erases data for sites you haven’t opened in a week — encryption keys included. It leaves apps in the Dock alone: File → Add to Dock.
storage.dock.title: Add Iskra to the Dock so Safari doesn’t erase it
storage.persist.message: When your disk runs low, Firefox may erase Iskra’s data — encryption keys included. It’s about to ask whether Iskra can keep them safely.
storage.persist.title: Keep your conversations safe?
